messages:
samira: Quick postmortem check-in — we had drift in private endpoint allowed-subnets this morning and it caused a small set of tenants to see TLS/auth errors. Need a compact rollback playbook.

alex: Agreed. We should make detection, isolation, rollback, validation steps. Keep commands ops-friendly. :thumbsup:

jordan: Important to call out TLS session cache and long-lived proxy connections — they kept failing after routes came back.

samira: Timeline: deploy changed endpoint policy -> control plane accepted -> dataplane route programming lagged ~30s -> some flows sticky to old nexthops -> auth errors.

ivy: Ops detail: control-plane vs dataplane separation makes quick acceptance easy but hides propagation delays. Add a route-flush & agent-restart step.

alex: Draft steps:
1) Detection: alert triggers (endpoint-error-rate or TLS handshake spikes).
2) Put endpoint into maintenance via API to pause rollouts.
3) Rollback config to tagged last-good commit (link to git).
4) Force dataplane reconcile: restart endpoint agent and reprogram peer routes.
5) Drain edge proxies / invalidate TLS caches.
6) Run smoke checks for control-plane health and tenant flows.

patrick: Suggest auto-rollback only for safe keys; peering/policy changes should require manual confirm.

ivy: Verification commands to include:
```
# check route from tenant
ip route show | grep <cp-prefix>
# validate agent status
curl -s https://local-agent/health | jq .version
```

jordan: Collect these evidence artifacts automatically: config diff, agent logs, tcpdump snippet, route table snapshot, cert status.

samira: Add customer comms checklist and escalation tree (oncall -> networking lead -> infra). Also set DNS TTL short during rollouts (60s).

alex: I'll put together a one-page runbook and a PR with a safe-key whitelist in config-metadata. Want reviews today.

infra-bot: Reminder: runbook automation policy requires runbook owner on-call for any automated rollbacks. https://policy.internal/automation-rollback

samira: Thanks — assign tasks: alex runbook, jordan validation scripts, ivy peering verification, patrick safe-key list. We'll merge and schedule a tabletop drill. :rocket:
